First, 8 weeks + 7 days = 8×7 + 7 = 56 + 7 = 63 days.  
Subtract 63 days from 1053-11-15.  
November has 30 days, so 1053-11-15 minus 15 days → 1053-10-31, still need 63 - 15 = 48 more days.  
October has 31 days, so 1053-10-31 minus 31 days → 1053-09-30, need 48 - 31 = 17 more days.  
September has 30 days, so 1053-09-30 minus 17 days → 1053-09-13.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1053-09-13
